text.p: Hungarian gas distributor Primagaz Rt plans sales of 20 billion to 22 billion forints in 1997, Primagaz's General Director said on Thursday.
"We plan to sell some 270,000 to 280,000 tonnes of gas this year," Zoltan Szemmelveisz told Reuters.
Szemmelveisz declined to give preliminary 1996 results, but said they would publish the figures on February 14.
Hungarian bourse-listed companies have to release their preliminary annual results by February 15.

He added that the company plans to invest some 3.5 billion forints in 1997 of which "80-85 percent towards expanding the client base". Szemmelveisz said the investments will be financed from own sources and loans but did not give details.
The company is 64.7 percent owned by PamGas B.V. of the Netherlands, while Austria's Osterreichische Kontrollbank holds 12.6 percent and CIE Geneva holds 5.3 percent.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, Primagaz shares closed unchanged at 9,000 forints.
